description_en: You can call SignOutGroup to check out an agent from the skill group they are currently signed into, which is equivalent to performing an unpublish operation for the agent
description_zh: 调用SignOutGroup使坐席签出当前签入的技能组，即坐席下线操作
kebab_example: aliyun ccc sign-out-group --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SignOutGroup

parameters.help_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账号映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id
